reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Mechanics in Provincia!
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how water interacts with terrain in Provincia. With our new native sparse CA system, ponds are now more efficient, and terrain modifications like digging and raising land are smoother than ever. You can finally turn on wells without freezing the frame! Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

steam.title: Water Mechanics Update in Provincia!
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce a major update to the water mechanics in Provincia! Our new system enhances how water interacts with terrain, making it more efficient and responsive. From now on, you can modify the terrain without any lag, and wells can be activated smoothly without freezing the game. For a deeper dive into these changes, check out our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
